plans.buy_case: HRL is setting up as a classic mean-reversion play: price is pinned near the lower Bollinger Band after a squeeze, MACD is turning up from the valley, and the golden cross (50MA > 200MA) provides a clean 200MA filter. Low VIX suggests complacency—a good contrarian entry point for a defensive consumer stock that should revert toward the 50MA.
plans.entry_condition: Wait for RSI to dip into the 20–30 buy zone OR price to touch the lower BB (≈$24.10). Do NOT chase at current RSI 45.9—you're too late in the setup. Patience wins here.
plans.exit_condition: Take profits at 50MA resistance (~$24.64) or if RSI breaks above 70 without follow-through volume. Hard stop: if price closes below 200MA ($22.85) on elevated volume—the setup is broken.
plans.risk: Fundamental health is 'neutral'—you're betting on technicals alone. If HRL reports weak earnings or dividend cuts during your hold, this unwinds fast. Also, low VIX can snap higher suddenly, killing mean-reversion trades. With only ~$319 allocation, position sizing is appropriate, but confirm dividend safety before entry.
